content.tagline: Three brands from one company: black ginseng, honey and make-up
content.descriptor: Joycos of Seoul: HUKSAMSOO black-ginseng skincare, the TRUE ISLAND honey and glacier-water lines, and HOPE GIRL colour cosmetics
about: Joycos Ltd. is a Korean company in Seoul that runs three brands at once. That is an unusual shape for our platform: a supplier normally arrives with one name, and here skincare and make-up sit under one roof.
HUKSAMSOO is built on black ginseng. TRUE ISLAND holds two lines: Honey Bee on honey, royal jelly and propolis, and Alaska Aqua on glacier water. HOPE GIRL is colour cosmetics: base, eyes and lips.
For a buyer this means a shelf can be assembled from a single source. Good-aging care, hydration, sun care and make-up arrive from one counterparty, under one contract and in one shipment.
By the company's account, ten items carry the European CPNP notification. The brands are sold on international marketplaces and in Korean retail.
facts: Joycos Ltd., Seoul, Seocho district; runs three brands: HUKSAMSOO, TRUE ISLAND and HOPE GIRL
In the catalogue the European CPNP mark appears on ten items of the Honey Bee line
HUKSAMSOO: black ginseng steamed and dried nine times over, about 1,200 hours at low heat
The HUKSAMSOO catalogue states KFDA functional marking for wrinkles and brightening
Alaska Aqua Hyaluron Sun Cream is stated as SPF50+ PA++++ with triple functionality
The Magic Lash eyelash serum carries a vegan mark and the patented BotaCair ingredient
Korean retail presence: Coupang, Naver Smart Store, MUSINSA, ABLY, BRANDI and K-beauty stores in Myeongdong

lines.name: HUKSAMSOO — the black ginseng line
lines.note: Six items: a water essence 150 ml, an emulsion 120 ml, an intensive firming serum 40 ml, a cream 50 ml, an eye cream 20 ml and a cleansing foam 150 ml. The company states niacinamide 50,000 ppm and panthenol 50,000 ppm in the essence, and niacinamide 20,000 ppm with adenosine 400 ppm in the emulsion and the eye cream. Free from parabens, denatured alcohol, artificial colours and mineral oil, as stated.

lines.name: HUKSAMSOO Black Ginseng EX PDRN Shot 120
lines.note: A separate 30 ml concentrate. The company describes delivery by spicules processed from natural sponge, a ginseng PDRN drawn from ginseng DNA, milk-derived exosomes in liposome form and an eight-peptide complex. The catalogue states KFDA functional marking for wrinkles and brightening.

lines.name: TRUE ISLAND · Honey Bee
lines.note: A line on honey, royal jelly and propolis, with bee venom in part of the range. Twelve items: hand creams in three scents, a collagen wash-off mask, an eye cream, a toner, a honey essence serum, a vitamin C serum, hydrogel eye patches, a multi cream, a cleansing foam, a gommage, a clay pore mask and a sheet mask.

lines.name: TRUE ISLAND · Alaska Aqua
lines.note: A hydration line on Alaska glacier water and triple hyaluronic acid. Six items: a cleansing foam, a gel cream, an SPF50+ PA++++ sun cream, a serum, a toner and an ultra-moisture mask.

lines.name: HOPE GIRL — colour cosmetics
lines.note: Base: a primer 35 g, a powder pact 21 g and a tone-up sun cream 40 g at SPF50+ PA+++. Cheeks and lips: a powder blusher and a lip tint, six shades each. Eyes: a glitter in four shades, an eyeliner and a brow pencil in two shades each, and a 9 g eyelash serum carrying a vegan mark.

tech.name: Black ginseng, processed nine times over
tech.note: The company describes the process as follows: ginseng is steamed and dried nine times, about 1,200 hours at low heat. By its account the content of the saponin Rg3 rises through this, and the company ties that saponin to collagen synthesis.

tech.name: Spicule delivery
tech.note: Black Ginseng EX PDRN Shot 120 is stated to contain spicules processed from natural sponge. The company describes them as micro-needles that open micro-channels in the outer layer and help actives travel deeper than they would from ordinary application.

tech.name: Plant-derived PDRN
tech.note: The company states that the PDRN in this line is drawn from ginseng DNA rather than being of animal origin. Milk-derived exosomes in liposome form and an eight-peptide complex are stated separately.

tech.name: Glacier water and triple hyaluronic acid
tech.note: The Alaska Aqua line is built on Alaska glacier water and three forms of hyaluronic acid of different molecular weight, which the company matches to hydration at different depths.

tech.name: Three brands in one shipment
tech.note: Skincare and make-up come from one supplier. For a buyer that is one contract, one shipment and one conversation about terms instead of three.

formats: Colour cosmetics for face, eyes and lips
content.exportNote: The company is looking for distributors abroad. It first named Europe and the United States; on 3 September 2026 Joycos confirmed in writing its interest in Latin America and noted that it has no buyers there yet and the market is open to it. Teranova covers Latin and North America and matches the brands with the countries and channels where botanical skincare and affordable make-up sell.

terms.label: Forms of cooperation
terms.value: Wholesale supply of finished goods under the HUKSAMSOO, TRUE ISLAND and HOPE GIRL brands. The company is open to importers, distributors, retail chains and online channels.

terms.label: Geography
terms.value: The company has confirmed its interest in Latin America and North America. The publication permission is non-exclusive: Teranova is not its agent or distributor.

terms.label: Prices
terms.value: Price on request. The company has not sent us a wholesale price list and we do not publish one openly. The buyer receives current terms at the deal stage through Teranova, as a separate line from the cost of our services.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: Minimum quantities depend on the brand and the item. The request goes through Teranova together with the request for prices.

terms.label: Documents
terms.value: By the company's account, ten items carry the European CPNP notification. Registration in Latin American countries is country by country, and its conditions are checked for the specific market and product at the deal stage.

terms.label: Samples
terms.value: Samples are discussed together with prices and minimum order quantities.

content.consentNote: Data, images and materials are provided by Joycos Ltd. and published with its written consent of 3 September 2026. Stated properties, formulations and markings are given on the company's information and its catalogues. Wholesale prices are not published.
